description: Modular workflow definitions referenced by workflow_id in the unified pipeline registry. Each workflow defines the procedural steps a case follows from intake through resolution.

steps.label: Safety Assessment
steps.description: Evaluate immediate safety risk. If active threat detected, route to crisis resources before proceeding.

steps.label: Document Collection
steps.description: Gather police reports, protection orders, medical records, photographs, and communication records.

steps.label: Timeline Reconstruction
steps.description: Build chronological timeline of incidents from documents and testimony.

steps.label: Benefits Navigation
steps.description: Match situation to available benefits: shelter, legal aid, financial assistance, counseling.

steps.label: Records Acquisition
steps.description: File public records requests for police reports, dispatch logs, and court records.

steps.label: Pattern Analysis
steps.description: Analyze documents for patterns of coercive control, escalation, or system failure.

steps.label: Resolution & Referral
steps.description: Generate case summary, referral package, and oversight complaint if warranted.

steps.label: Situation Assessment
steps.description: Classify dispute type: habitability, eviction, discrimination, lease violation, or retaliation.

steps.label: Document Collection
steps.description: Gather lease, correspondence, photographs, inspection reports, and payment records.

steps.label: Regulatory Analysis
steps.description: Map violations to applicable local, state, and federal housing regulations.

steps.label: Records Acquisition
steps.description: Request inspection records, code enforcement history, and building permits from municipal agencies.

steps.label: Benefits Navigation
steps.description: Match to emergency housing, utility assistance, and legal aid programs.

steps.label: Resolution & Escalation
steps.description: Generate complaint letter, HUD filing, or attorney general referral as appropriate.

steps.label: Denial Analysis
steps.description: Parse denial letter to extract reason codes, policy citations, and appeal deadlines.

steps.label: Document Collection
steps.description: Gather policy documents, claims history, medical records, and prior correspondence.

steps.label: Contract & Compliance Review
steps.description: Analyze policy language against denial rationale. Identify regulatory violations.

steps.label: Appeal Preparation
steps.description: Draft internal appeal with supporting evidence and regulatory citations.

steps.label: External Review & Escalation
steps.description: File external review request, insurance commissioner complaint, or attorney general referral.

steps.label: Pattern Detection
steps.description: Cross-reference denial against known insurer patterns and industry-wide denial rates.

steps.label: Wage Calculation
steps.description: Calculate owed wages from pay stubs, timesheets, and employment records.

steps.label: Document Collection
steps.description: Gather pay stubs, contracts, timesheets, W-2/1099 forms, and employee handbook.

steps.label: Classification Analysis
steps.description: Determine if worker is misclassified. Apply IRS and DOL classification tests.

steps.label: Complaint Filing
steps.description: Prepare and file complaint with state labor agency or US Department of Labor.

steps.label: Benefits Navigation
steps.description: Connect to unemployment insurance, legal aid, and emergency assistance.

steps.label: Pattern Analysis & Escalation
steps.description: Check for employer-wide patterns. Escalate to DOL if systematic violations found.

steps.label: Safety & Urgency Assessment
steps.description: Evaluate child safety status and urgency of intervention needed.

steps.label: Document Collection
steps.description: Gather CPS records, court filings, school records, medical records, and case plans.

steps.label: System Failure Analysis
steps.description: Identify procedural failures, missed deadlines, and policy violations by child welfare agencies.

steps.label: Benefits Navigation
steps.description: Connect family to childcare, food assistance, healthcare, and legal representation.

steps.label: Records Acquisition
steps.description: File records requests for CPS investigation files, placement records, and court documents.

steps.label: Resolution & Advocacy
steps.description: Generate case summary, advocacy brief, and oversight referral if warranted.

steps.label: Debt Validation
steps.description: Verify debt validity: statute of limitations, correct debtor, accurate amount.

steps.label: Document Collection
steps.description: Gather collection letters, call logs, credit reports, original agreements, and court filings.

steps.label: FDCPA Violation Analysis
steps.description: Map collector behavior against FDCPA provisions. Identify specific violations.

steps.label: Complaint Filing
steps.description: File CFPB complaint and/or state attorney general consumer protection complaint.

steps.label: Benefits Navigation
steps.description: Connect to legal aid, debt counseling, and emergency financial assistance.

steps.label: Pattern Detection
steps.description: Cross-reference collector against CFPB complaint database for pattern violations.

steps.label: Ward Status Assessment
steps.description: Determine current status of the ward: location, health, access to family, financial condition.

steps.label: Document Collection
steps.description: Gather guardianship orders, financial accountings, visitor reports, and medical records.

steps.label: Financial Forensic Analysis
steps.description: Trace asset flows from ward's accounts. Identify unauthorized transactions or depletion patterns.

steps.label: Records Acquisition
steps.description: Request court records, guardian accountings, and APS investigation files.

steps.label: Oversight Referral
steps.description: File complaints with probate court, APS, and state bar if attorney-guardian involved.

steps.label: Pattern Analysis
steps.description: Check for same guardian across multiple wards. Identify professional guardian networks.

steps.label: Safety Assessment
steps.description: Evaluate immediate safety of the elder. If active abuse detected, route to APS and crisis resources.

steps.label: Document Collection
steps.description: Gather medical records, financial records, facility inspection reports, and photographs.

steps.label: Abuse Type Classification
steps.description: Classify abuse type: physical, emotional, financial, neglect, or abandonment.

steps.label: Records Acquisition
steps.description: Request facility inspection reports, APS records, and CMS deficiency reports.

steps.label: Benefits Navigation
steps.description: Connect to elder care services, legal aid, healthcare, and protective services.

steps.label: Resolution & Escalation
steps.description: Generate case summary, APS complaint, facility complaint, or law enforcement referral.

steps.label: Family Locate & Status
steps.description: Determine location and custody status of all family members. Identify which agencies hold jurisdiction.

steps.label: Document Collection
steps.description: Gather immigration filings, detention records, court orders, and consular communications.

steps.label: Due Process Review
steps.description: Analyze proceedings for due process violations, procedural errors, or rights violations.

steps.label: Records Acquisition
steps.description: File FOIA/Privacy Act requests with ICE, CBP, USCIS, and ORR for detention and processing records.

steps.label: Benefits Navigation
steps.description: Connect to immigration legal services, refugee assistance, healthcare, and community support.

steps.label: Reunification & Advocacy
steps.description: Prepare reunification petition, congressional inquiry, or DHS complaint as appropriate.

workflows.label: Mental Health System Case Workflow
workflows.voice: I believe you. You were there. Let's look at what they actually did.

steps.label: Belief & Grounding
steps.description: Acknowledge the person's experience without clinical framing. Establish what happened from their perspective first. No diagnosis language. No institutional voice. Their words.

steps.label: Records Acquisition
steps.description: Identify and request all relevant records: treatment records, hold petitions, medication logs, discharge summaries, incident reports. Use HIPAA right of access. Document any refusals.

steps.label: Timeline Reconstruction
steps.description: Build a chronological timeline from the person's account and the records. Flag gaps where records are missing or contradict the person's experience. Every gap is evidence.

steps.label: Rights Verification
steps.description: Check whether statutory rights were honored: was a hearing held within the required timeframe? Were patient rights notices provided? Was informed consent obtained? Were restraint limits followed?

steps.label: Pattern Analysis
steps.description: Identify systemic patterns: repeated holds, escalating medication without monitoring, restraint as punishment, family exclusion as policy. Patterns reveal whether this was individual failure or institutional practice.

steps.label: Oversight & Accountability
steps.description: Map the oversight entities with jurisdiction. File complaints where warranted. Connect to Protection & Advocacy organizations. Document everything filed and every response received.

steps.label: Voice Restoration
steps.description: Help the person document their experience in their own words. If records need amendment, prepare the formal request. If the story needs to be told, build the narrative from verified facts. Their voice, their record, their truth.
